notes: וְהָיָה carries no complementizer here: the ASV writes *And it shall be* with no *that*, so rule 45 leaves nothing to place.

In כִּי טוֹב לוֹ עִמָּךְ the recasting makes the dative the English subject, so לְ is unrepresented under rule 40 and its suffix takes *he*; טוֹב keeps *is well*, headed on the complement under rule 44.
